exposure: level of knowledge regarding postpartum hemorrhage prevention and management
level of skills regarding postpartum hemorrhage prevention and management
outcome: knowledge scores in postpartum hemorrhage prevention and management
skill scores in postpartum hemorrhage prevention and management
cohort: The study included 110 student nurse-midwives from two colleges of health and allied sciences in Tanzania.
finding: Most student nurse-midwives from site A demonstrated poor knowledge, while those from site B showed moderate knowledge, and over three-quarters from both sites exhibited poor skills in the prevention and management of postpartum hemorrhage.
cross-section timing: After completing the midwifery module in the diploma program, prior to commencing their clinical practice.
